radial_dent_1_percent.question: does a +-1 % shape error move the measurement by ~1 %?

which_reading_discriminates.question: the gated metric is the integral; does it see a +-1 % dent as well as the pointwise one?
which_reading_discriminates.note: on a closed surface int S dA is nearly shape-invariant, so a 2 % gate on it is a weak discriminator; the pointwise reading is the sensitive one and it is the untested one

scaled_mesh_stale_reference.question: is the measured value independent of the analytic reference?

sphere_with_stale_radius.question: same sphere, reference for R = 2 -- only the reported error may change

conclusion: the measured side is computed from mesh vertices and faces only; the analytic reference enters through reference_sum() and nothing else, so the +0.0119 % headline is a geometry measurement and not a restatement of 2/R
